claims_checked.claim: Talking on the phone on a train is generally not a criminal law.
claims_checked.note: Operator manners requests; staff can ask you to stop.

claims_checked.claim: Railways announce silent mode and refrain from calls; priority seats often have stricter notices.
claims_checked.note: Common JR/private operator マナー broadcasts; older 'turn off near priority seats' wording has changed by operator—article tells readers to read current stickers.

claims_checked.claim: Texting and silent phone use are normal.
Sleeping is allowed because it is more private than a call.
claims_checked.note: Article frames difference as who is conscripted to listen, not a legal ranking.

notes: Do not invent exact yen, fine, or survey percentages
